summary_en: 24,000 shares (0.10% of S/O), ¥30M upper limit, open-market purchase Aug 21–Sep 30, 2026. Purpose: capital efficiency and responsive capital policy amid changing business environment.
title_en: Notice of Resolution Regarding Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (acquisition of treasury stock based on articles of incorporation under Article 165, paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 12 August 2026, the board of Gourmet Kishiya (code 9850, TSE Prime) resolved to acquire up to 24,000 treasury shares at a cost not exceeding ¥30 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from 21 August through 30 September 2026. The 24,000 shares represent 0.10% of shares outstanding (computed as 24,000 ÷ 22,874,025 ex-treasury shares = 0.105%, rounded to 0.1%). The stated purpose is to improve capital efficiency and to conduct responsive capital policy in response to changing business conditions. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 36,250 treasury shares.
